truth_boundary: Strategies describe how Buddy and bots improve over time. Promotion still requires regression gates and owner approval.

strategies.name: Spaced Repetition
strategies.summary: Revisit skills on expanding intervals to retain mastery.
strategies.test: Schedule review items at day 1, 3, 7; mark retained if passed twice.

strategies.name: Active Recall
strategies.summary: Test retrieval instead of re-reading notes.
strategies.test: Hide notes; answer; reveal; score accuracy.

strategies.name: Interleaving
strategies.summary: Mix related skill types in one practice block.
strategies.test: Alternate 3 task types; compare vs blocked practice.

strategies.name: Deliberate Practice
strategies.summary: Target weakest subskill with immediate feedback.
strategies.test: Isolate lowest rubric score; run 5 focused drills.

strategies.name: Error Analysis
strategies.summary: Cluster failures by root cause; fix causes not symptoms.
strategies.test: Bucket 10 failures; name root causes; propose one fix each.

strategies.name: Curriculum Learning
strategies.summary: Train from easy → hard examples.
strategies.test: Order tasks by difficulty; unlock next only after pass.

strategies.name: Contrastive Learning
strategies.summary: Learn boundaries by comparing good vs bad examples.
strategies.test: Present pair good/bad; state rule that separates them.

strategies.name: Meta-Learning
strategies.summary: Learn which strategy works for which task class.
strategies.test: Log strategy used vs outcome; update strategy→task map.

strategies.name: Reinforcement from Feedback
strategies.summary: Increase weight of actions that earn positive outcomes.
strategies.test: Adjust weights only after N≥5 outcomes; require regression gate.

strategies.name: Imitation Learning
strategies.summary: Clone expert traces (approved human or golden runs).
strategies.test: Match expert steps ≥80% on held-out golden set.

strategies.name: Self-Play / Self-Challenge
strategies.summary: Generate harder variants of tasks you already pass.
strategies.test: Create 3 harder variants; attempt; log new failures.

strategies.name: Knowledge Distillation
strategies.summary: Compress long traces into short playbooks and prompts.
strategies.test: Reduce successful trace to ≤10 steps without losing outcome.

strategies.name: Human-in-the-Loop Correction
strategies.summary: Owner edits become supervised labels for future runs.
strategies.test: Store before/after; never auto-promote without gate.

strategies.name: Benchmark-Driven Improvement
strategies.summary: Close the lowest failing benchmark dimension first.
strategies.test: Pick min score dimension; plan; remeasure.

strategies.name: Multi-Perspective Study
strategies.summary: Study the same problem from code, product, risk, and user views.
strategies.test: Produce 4 perspective notes; merge conflicts explicitly.

strategies.name: Dependency Reduction Learning
strategies.summary: Prefer local/native skills over external paid dependencies.
strategies.test: Score native vs external ratio; plan reduction steps.

strategies.name: Failure Memory
strategies.summary: Persist failure signatures so the same mistake is not repeated.
strategies.test: Lookup similar past failure before proposing fix.

strategies.name: Bootcamp Mastery Gates
strategies.summary: Progress only after lesson checks pass.
strategies.test: Lesson quiz must pass before next lesson unlock.

strategies.name: Transfer Learning
strategies.summary: Apply skills from one division/bot to a related domain.
strategies.test: Map source skills → target task; list gaps.

strategies.name: Continuous Learning Cycle
strategies.summary: Observe → hypothesize → test in sandbox → measure → promote or discard.
strategies.test: One cycle produces evidence artifact and pass/fail decision.
